patient_identity.statement: Unique male MAU2 deletion case matches coding/protein variant, severe CdLS and gestational30weekIUGR. Source reports current age14 but last clinical evaluation at10; packet timeAtLastEncounter14 should retain that distinction. Clinical diagnosis made at2years.

evidence.locator: STARMethods Detailed characterization,e3;Results pp2-3

limitations: Source current age is not necessarily age of last examination. CdLS7/OMIM621570 is later nomenclature; source uses CdLS without that subtype number.

genotype.statement: Source reports monoallelic MAU2 NM_015329:c.927_947del, p.(Gln310_Ala316del), a21bp in-frame deletion, concordant with packet coding/protein call and heterozygous interpretation. Figure1B gives34%of54patientreads.

evidence.locator: Results p2;Figure1A-C;STARMethods e3

limitations: Transcript version .4 and protein accession .3 are not specified in publication. Source alignment useshg19, while packet useshg38. Exact GRCh38genomic mapping and equivalence of VCFleft-aligned deletion19342815-19342835 versus hgvs.g19342820-19342840 were not independently normalized.
34%allele fraction is not itself proof of mosaicism; no cross-tissue quantification supplied.

segregation.statement: Trio sequencing and Sanger traces support source-reported de novo variant: Figure1B patient34%of54reads,mother0%of58,father0%of45. Both parents reported healthy/nonconsanguineous.

evidence.locator: Figure1A/B and STARMethods e3

limitations: Parentage and low-level parental/germline mosaicism not independently assessed; zero observed parental reads is not absolute absence.

phase.statement: One heterozygous MAU2 allele; no compound-heterozygous cis/trans question is presented.

evidence.locator: Results p2;Figure1A/B

causal_confidence.statement: Authors attribute CdLS to this novel de novo in-frame deletion. Conserved region, reduced mammalian interaction to46%ofwildtype, yeast two-hybrid findings and patient-fibroblast expression overlap support biological plausibility.

evidence.locator: Results pp2-4;Figures1/2,S1/S2;Discussion

limitations: Single affected MAU2 individual; no independent recurrent pedigree or isogenic patient rescue in this source. Packet formalPATHOGENIC label exceeds a reproduced contemporary ACMG assessment; source pathogenic attribution retained as source claim.

RNA comparison uses one maleMAU2donor,one femaleNIPBLdonor andone femalecontrol in triplicate; excluding sex-chromosome genes does not eliminate donor confounding. R=.79 is a gene-level correlation, not independent patient replication.

Most subsequent functional experiments concern engineered homozygousNIPBLc.39dup celllines or a different NIPBLsplice-site patient. Their alternative-initiation mechanism is not shown to rescue the MAU2 patient; authors explicitly do not expect MAU2deletion to trigger it.
Protein instability/NIPBLhaploinsufficiency in the MAU2case is a proposed mechanistic chain; interaction/readouts do not establish every causal step in the patient.
